items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: then, we got Joe Hooven in there and, of course, they needed a better reader than me to play those shows. So, of course, naturally, Hooven and I being such good friends, I talked up a storm for him and they got him in.

ctx.x: And, that was primarily what you did---

That's primarily what I did. And, I got by fine on that. And, I met - during that time - I met a wonderful trumpet player named Joe Hooven and we sort of -- he was great reader and player and, uh, we worked out some nice little things together when we worked together, you know - and, so, we were kind of like a team.
You were 20 years old now -- I'm just throwing that in---
